title: Builder-Delay Waivers on Builder Extended Rate Lock Extension Charges
content:
A builder-delay waiver takes part or all of an extension fee charge off the lock charges owed on a Builder Extended Rate Lock. The waiver stands on the lock ledger against the charge number it waives.

## Rule

- The builder-delay waiver is not fixed until the lock ledger carries, under its own charge number, the extension charge for the days added to reach the moved closing date.
- The waiver is booked on the lock ledger with waiver reason builder delay.

Restated on the ledger: the waiver acts on an extension charge that already stands on the lock ledger with its own charge number for those days; until the ledger shows that charge, there is no charge for the waiver to name and no waiver amount.

## Tool: `waive_builder_delay_charge_21040a50`

**What it does.** One call waives part or all of an extension fee charge on a Builder Extended Rate Lock because of a builder delay: it writes one waiver on the lock ledger that names the charge number waived, records the reason as builder delay, and takes the waived amount off the lock charges owed. The buyer sees the waiver against that charge number.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `waive_builder_delay_charge_21040a50` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `lock_id` | The reference number of the Builder Extended Rate Lock carrying the charge, as returned by the rate lock finder | identifier as returned by the finder |
| `source_charge_ref` | The printed charge number of the extension fee charge being waived | verbatim: exactly as it appears on the lock ledger or on the receipt that booked it, copied character for character with no change |
| `amount` | The amount waived | USD, a plain number rounded to 2 decimal places (half up, to the cent), no currency sign |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `status` "waived", the `lock_id`, the `source_charge_ref` (the charge number waived), the `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), the `waiver_reason` ("builder_delay") and `charges_due` (USD, 2 decimal places, the lock charges owed net of the waiver). No other return or error is defined for the tool.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call naming `source_charge_ref` LCK-CHG-4517 with `amount` 386.57 returns status "waived" against LCK-CHG-4517 and lowers the lock charges owed by 386.57.
